BiblicalUsage: Omets means strength. It occurs once, in Job 17:9, where the righteous holds on his way, and he that has clean hands is stronger and stronger.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the righteous grow stronger on the way, and clean hands are the strength that lasts.
